newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T gets favourable U.S. tobacco ruling.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T gets favourable U.S. tobacco ruling.

text.p: Britain's B.A.T Industries Plc said on Tuesday a Missouri court ruled in its favour by granting its motion to be dismissed from a U.S. tobacco suit.
The case was dismissed for lack of personal jurisdiction, B.A.T quoted the judgement as saying.

The plaintiff, Barbara Smith, had sought to demonstrate that the conglomerate was in the business of selling tobacco. The U.S. district court, however, ruled that B.A.T simply has interests in companies that sell tobacco products.

"Plaintiff points to activities attributed to "the group', but the context of these statements demonstrates that "the group' refers to (B.A.T Industries') tobacco companies and not to actions taken by (B.A.T Industries)," the group quoted the court as ruling.
